zh: 口令喷洒：少量常见口令尝试许多账户。
账户锁定：多次失败后禁止登录。
单点登录：一次认证访问多个应用。
多因素认证：要求两种以上认证因素。
限速：限制单位时间内的尝试次数。
凭据：用于认证的用户名和口令。
en: Password spraying: trying a few common passwords against many accounts.
Account lockout: disabling login after repeated failures.
Single sign-on: one authentication for multiple applications.
Multi-factor authentication: requiring two or more authentication factors.
Throttling: limiting attempts per unit time.
Credential: a username and password used for authentication.
